title: Python-maintenance workflow used unsupported job-level runner context and unannotated literal Markdown
title_de: Python-Wartungsworkflow verwendete nicht unterstützten jobweiten Runner-Kontext und nicht annotiertes literales Markdown
protocol: GitHub Actions context availability and workflow lint
profile: Framework CPython 3.13 updater Draft PR exact-head CI remediation
technical_claim: Exact-head actionlint rejected runner.temp in candidate-validate's job-level env, where runner is unavailable. ShellCheck also classified literal Markdown backticks in the printf body as SC2016 without a local annotation. The workflow-lint job consequently never reached its downstream security-contract test.
entry_point: PR #39 exact-head CI security workflow lint job.
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: Job-level env expression evaluation rejects runner.temp before the candidate job can start; unannotated single-quoted backticks cause static shell lint failure.
attacker_prerequisites: None; this is a deterministic authored workflow validation failure.
observed_behavior: Run 29774954611/job 88461998115 failed with three runner-context diagnostics at lines 54-56 and two SC2016 diagnostics for literal PR-body prose.
expected_behavior: Runner temporary locations are established at step runtime via $RUNNER_TEMP/$GITHUB_ENV, and intended literal Markdown backticks have a narrow ShellCheck annotation rather than executable expansion.
impact: The scheduled/manual updater workflow cannot pass repository workflow lint, so its security contract and candidate validation are not eligible for verified PR delivery.
preconditions: The maintenance workflow is linted by the pinned actionlint/ShellCheck CI job.
reproduction: Run the PR #39 exact-head workflow-lint job or the repository workflow lint check on the original head.

evidence.summary: actionlint rejected runner.temp at job env scope; ShellCheck emitted SC2016 for literal Markdown backticks.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped complete remediation validation: 36 focused tests, 85 CI-security tests, workflow lint, workflow contract, documentation checks, full native lint, and final security-diff finalization
evidence.summary: The remediated workflow avoids job-level runner context and scopes the SC2016 annotation to the literal PR-body printf; local workflow and CI-security gates passed.

root_cause: The new workflow used a valid step-level context at job-level scope and did not distinguish intentionally literal backticks from shell substitutions.
proposed_remediation: Retain only CANDIDATE at job scope; initialize all runner paths in a candidate step by appending fixed $RUNNER_TEMP paths to $GITHUB_ENV; add a single local SC2016 suppression immediately before the literal body printf. Do not alter permissions, triggers, pins, or Draft publication semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate validation retains isolated runner-temporary build/cache/state paths.
PR-body Markdown remains literal and ShellCheck passes.
Workflow and CI-security contracts still pass.
validation_plan: Run workflow lint and the owning security contract suite locally, then validate the new exact-head hosted workflow-lint check.
legitimate_control_tests: The workflow still writes only runner-owned paths and uses a literal `.python-version` Markdown reference in the Draft PR body.
bypass_review: Confirm context movement does not add job privileges or secret exposure, and the ShellCheck directive covers only the immediately intended literal printf.
deduplication_note: No prior finding records these new workflow syntax/lint failures.
evidence_limitations: The hosted log is sufficient deterministic failure evidence; no secret or privileged action was exercised.
residual_risk: The local remediation is fixed, but PR delivery remains blocked until the remediated commit is pushed and its exact head passes hosted workflow lint and all other required checks.

history.detail: PR #39 actionlint/ShellCheck diagnostics identified the authored maintenance-workflow defects.

Runner paths now initialize at step runtime through the runner-owned environment, and the one SC2016 annotation is limited to literal Markdown. Workflow lint, CI-security tests, focused tests, native full lint, and the sealed follow-up scan passed; hosted current-head evidence remains pending.
